seed: Assume some mechanic is not a function of the visible state, for example a turn order, a patrol route or a hidden counter. Carry hidden state across calls, gated on continuity.

synth.notes: Mirror-blocks/marker game. Blocks (cyan 4x4) move on a 4px grid: a1/2 = y-4/y+4, a3/4 = apart/together; a5/7 no-op. Click on inactive marker arms it (color_11) and converts blocks to players; 1-4 then move only the active marker; click on player reverts to blocks; other clicks no-op. Bars w=floor(3*(a+1)/7), a=actions this level (hidden counter; on discontinuity re-infer a=(7w-1)//3 or 0). Maze cells {(6,18),(14,38),(38,14)} + marker/player cells block moves. Names re-ranked by (y,x): blocks 0,1 in block mode; all from 0 in armed mode. Open: boundary cells untested; action 7 unobserved (treated as no-op).
